O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the media manager type name; the metainfo addon's listener (and the core article list in mediapool.php) are separate addons that only feed the same EP, and article/category/clang names are 'editor content', so a solver can argue they are a different feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The in-use warning and the delete exception message are intentionally HTML (<ul><li><a href=javascript:openPage(...)>) rendered raw; escaping the aggregated $uses / exception message or the EP subject breaks the clickable links. Separately, the effects prio-field label callback returns a raw short name that rex_select already escapes, so adding rex_escape there double-escapes.
